latest_final: I was frying food in oil in the pantry off the hall. The frying released airborne grease particles, which reached a nearby smoke detector and triggered the fire alarm. There was no fire; the alarm was set off by the cooking aerosol.

checkpoints.evidence: “frying food in oil... released airborne grease particles” and “There was no fire”
checkpoints.reason: Identifies cooking fumes and distinguishes them from a fire, but does not establish that the cooking was at high temperature or that the food was not burned.

checkpoints.evidence: No mention of the exhaust fan.
checkpoints.reason: Does not state that the exhaust fan was left off.
